title: EYE Configuration Schema
description: JSON Schema for EYE AI Forensic Assistant configuration file

model_name.description: Name of the model to use (e.g., 'gpt-4', 'llama2', 'claude-3')

executable_path.description: Path to executable for CLI agents (required for local_cli integration_type)

api_endpoint.description: API endpoint URL for local API servers (required for local_api integration_type)

last_validated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last successful connectivity validation

embedding.description: Optional semantic-retrieval embedding server (e.g. Ollama). When disabled or unreachable, the Eye falls back to the always-available BM25 lexical ranker, so Cloud/CLI deployments are unaffected.

enabled.description: Enable embedding-backed semantic retrieval for the knowledge base (and, if index_evidence is set, the forensic data). Requires a reachable embedding server.

model.description: Embedding model name. nomic-embed-text(-v1.5) applies search_query:/search_document: task prefixes automatically.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the embedding server (Ollama API).

index_evidence.description: Build a per-case semantic index over a curated subset of forensic data rows, enabling semantic_search_artifacts (discovery layer; SQL stays authoritative). No effect unless enabled is also true.

context_window.description: Context window and token budget configuration. All fields are optional; the Eye supplies defaults for any that are absent.

max_total_tokens.description: Fallback context window size (tokens) for models whose real window is unknown. For known cloud models the real window is auto-resolved and this is ignored unless lock_max_total_tokens is true; local servers are sized by their runtime n_ctx probe.

lock_max_total_tokens.description: Pin max_total_tokens to the configured value and disable automatic resolution to the backend model's real context window.

max_tool_output_chars.description: Maximum characters allowed for tool output before memory truncation

store_full_payload.description: Persist the full payload sent to the model per evidence seal so the Compliance log can reproduce (not just verify) each turn.

sealed_payload_recent_uncompressed.description: Keep this many recent sealed payloads uncompressed; older ones are compressed (zstd, gzip fallback).

token_budget.description: Optional per-component token allocation. When absent it is auto-scaled to the resolved context window; an explicit value pins it.

sliding_window_size.description: Number of recent messages to preserve

preserve_first_message.description: Whether to always preserve the first message

preserve_tool_messages.description: Whether to preserve messages containing tool calls

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum confidence score (0.0-1.0) to preserve evidence

reasoning.description: Investigator-grade reasoning behaviors (v0.11.1). All fields optional; the Eye supplies defaults (all ON) for any that are absent. Disable to cap cost/latency on small or local backends.

enable_decomposition.description: Decompose multi-part questions into a sub-question checklist and correlate the partial answers into a final consolidated answer.

max_sub_questions.description: Maximum number of sub-questions a single query is split into.

enable_premise_verification.description: Treat factual claims the investigator makes as hypotheses to prove or disprove against artifacts, and report a verdict.

enable_question_memory.description: Persist a per-question answer summary + extracted findings to eye_question_memory.jsonl and reuse them on related follow-up questions.

prior_findings_count.description: How many recent prior-question findings to surface to the model for reuse.

model_retry_max_attempts.description: Max attempts for a model call when the provider returns a transient error (e.g. Gemini 500/INTERNAL); exponential backoff between attempts.

auto_segment_question.description: Let the LLM break a big/complex question into focused logical sub-questions (vs. only splitting genuinely multi-part questions). The model decides the split; there is no character-length rule.

enable_auto_map_reduce.description: Automatically analyze a very large query result via map-reduce (chunked, each segment sealed) instead of feeding a sample.

auto_map_reduce_row_threshold.description: A query_database result with at least this many rows is auto-routed through map-reduce.

enable_reasoning_trace.description: After answering a decomposed question, capture WHY each sub-question was created and WHY each conclusion follows from which evidence (a sealed, tool-less structured pass) to eye_reasoning_log.jsonl for the Compliance UI.

answer_temperature.description: Sampling temperature for the investigative/synthesis (answer) model calls. Lower = more deterministic, evidence-faithful output.

planning_temperature.description: Sampling temperature for the planning + reasoning-trace passes. Near-zero for repeatable decomposition.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum tokens the model may generate per reply (bounds the answer, not the context window).

rag_top_k.description: Maximum number of ranked knowledge-base chunks to retrieve (semantic or lexical) beyond the deterministic keyword-mapped docs.

rag_min_score.description: Minimum relevance score (0-1) for a ranked knowledge-base chunk to be included.

rag_subquestion_aware.description: After decomposition, also retrieve targeted knowledge for each sub-question (not just the main query).

rag_semantic_min_score.description: Minimum cosine similarity (0-1) for a SEMANTIC (embedding) knowledge-base chunk to be included. Only applies when an embedding server is configured; the lexical fallback uses rag_min_score.

history_window_turns.description: Number of most-recent conversation turns kept VERBATIM (the sliding window). Older non-protected turns are folded into a single rolling summary (the summarization buffer). Evidence/pinned turns and the first turn are always kept.

enable_summary_buffer.description: Stage 1 of the two-stage memory policy: fold older non-protected turns into a rolling summary before the sliding-window drop. When false, only the sliding-window drop (Stage 2) applies.

enable_conversation_recall.description: Long-term memory: retrieve earlier turns that were summarized / slid out of the live window (by relevance to the current query) and inject them as a 'Recalled Earlier Conversation' block, so nothing is truly lost when the window fills.

conversation_recall_top_k.description: Maximum number of recalled earlier conversation turns to inject per query.

search_max_rows.description: Maximum rows returned by the global forensic search tool (search_artifacts).
